_comment: Lewd Anatomy concept tables. These texts are encoded into SEGA concept conditionings; they never appear in the prompt.
Every slider has five steps: -2, -1, 0 (neutral, nothing computed), +1, +2; a one-sided slider (no 'below': Anatomy fix, Wrinkles) has 0, +1, +2. 'below' names -2 and -1, 'levels' names +1 and +2.
An entry is {"text", "direction" (toward | away), "scale" (relative, default 1), "warmup" (optional, 0-1 of the steps)}. A plain string is a 'toward' entry.

A step v computes at most three concepts: toward the entry of v, away from the entry of the opposite side's first step (-1 for +v, +1 for -v), and on the + side, away from 'cap' unless Allow exaggerated.
Strength of a step = base_scale * Strength * step_gain[|v|] * role factor * entry scale. step_gain keeps +-2 a steady step up from +-1, not a jump.
The engine appends each text to the user's prompt and guides against the prompt's own prediction, so the scene and clothes cancel.
Concept strings are anatomy only: no garment and no whole-person name, because those drag a default outfit.
Anime tags are checked against the Danbooru tag list shipped with tag-autocomplete (danbooru.csv). No entry may address age.
taper: each concept's edit fades to 0 over the last share of its window (no abrupt low-noise edits, which smear detail).
face_every / face_threshold: Protect face recomputes its face mask every N steps; the face is where the probe words' attention is above this share of its peak.
A step's entry may be a list: several separate concepts on that step (Anatomy fix). A slider with no 'below' names is one-sided: 0, +1, +2.
A profile with an empty table ({}) has no fitting concept (no Danbooru tag that does not drag clothes or something else in): the slider is off there, with a note.
clashes: slider pairs that pull one body part opposite ways at these signs; both lose their 'opposite' push and the status line says so.
phase 'fix' (Anatomy fix): runs from 30 % of the range on, never in the composition-setting first steps; 'area' is the slider's own Concept mask area.
stale_decay: with Rotate (or more concepts than Max concepts), a concept's kept difference fades by this factor for every step it is reused (it was measured on an earlier latent).
An entry's 'unless' lists regions: the entry is left out while a slider in one of them is moved (Anatomy fix vs the chest and genital sliders).
phases: each slider's 'phase' runs in that part of the step range (fractions of start..end): shape early (to 0.8), detail late (from 0.3, on past the end to 1.15), fix (Anatomy fix) 0.3-0.85.
control: the gain every edit gets in each Control mode; Sliders also turns Perp-Neg off.

Small parts of the frame (vulva, anus, nipples, genital textures) have their own small mask 'area' 0.1, and Vulva runs as a detail slider: early in the steps their words' attention is spread over the whole image, and an edit there re-coloured hair and moved hands.

overlap_budget: wherever several sliders edit the same pixels, their summed edit there stays within this many times the strongest single slider at that pixel. 'region' groups sliders: an entry's 'unless', detail_after_shape, wait_for and region_warn.

Pose tab ('scope': 'global', phase 'pose'): the whole picture, in the first 35 % of the schedule whatever Range start says (composition is set there); no concept mask, no Protect face, never in the hires pass. The + steps push away from the -1 entry, the checkpoint's stock pose / eye-level shot / straight gaze. Pose energy names no standing pose, so a sitting or lying prompt stays sitting or lying.

keep_face (Pose energy, Camera height): with Protect face on, the slider's edit is zeroed on the face like a body slider's, and the face mask is refreshed every step while it runs. Reduces face changes, cannot stop them.

nudity_lock: automatic, no slider. When the prompt asks for full nudity (nude, completely nude, naked) and names no partial nudity (topless, shirtless...), no garment and no clothed person, one concept pushes away from clothes (measured from the prompt, its own mask area 0.5). Never in the hires pass or on tiles.

'face': 'features' (Facial hair, Skin realism, Skin tone, Cum, the marks, Wrinkles): with Protect face on, the edit is zeroed only on the core of the face mask (eyes, eyebrows, nose and lips, above face_core_threshold of the peak), so it can reach jaw, chin, cheeks and upper lip.
The face probe text is '<prompt>, face, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips'.

Warnings: warn_time (expected extra time, 8.0 = +800 %) in the status line and the console; region_warn (this many sliders moved on one region) in the status line; overlap_warn (share of the image where the per-pixel cap cut a multi-slider spot below 60 %) once per pass in the console.

Overlap merge: before the per-pixel cap, the sliders' edits go through sign election (as TIES merging): on each latent value the minority's opposite push is dropped instead of cancelling, so agreeing sliders keep more of the budget.

fuse: sliders of one part (breasts, nipples, penis, vulva, testicles) moved together become one concept per role, within one phase (Penis + Erection apart from Veins + Wetness + Foreskin; Testicles apart from Scrotum), their texts joined ('large areolae, erect nipples, brown nipples'), at the strongest member's scale. detail_after_shape: in a region where a shape concept runs, detail concepts start at this share of the range.
edit_cap: at every pixel the summed slider edit stays within this many times the prompt's own CFG push there (smoothed, floor = a quarter of its mean). Needs CFG > 1. 0 = off.

mask_words: the words of a concept its mask is read from (pubic, armpit, chest, arm, leg...). CLIP ties a bare 'hair' to the hair on the head: read from every token, the Hair tab's masks took in the head and face. Hair concepts name where the hair is and avoid generic 'detailed hair'.

wait_for: regions (or '*' = any) whose running shape concepts make this detail slider start at detail_after_shape too. shape_after_pose: while a Pose slider runs, shape sliders start at this share of the Pose window.

Marks (Scars, Moles, Birthmarks, Freckles; Hair & marks tab): detail, body-wide masks read from their own nouns, Protect face keeps only the face core. The prompt says where (scar on chest, mole under eye).

Wrinkles: one-sided (0, +1 fine lines, +2 deep), a skin detail like the marks. No minus side: smoothing wrinkles away is pulling toward a younger look; Skin realism already covers airbrushed skin. Age itself is the prompt's.
Caps: a slider's cap is dropped while another moved slider pushes toward one of its tags (Hips + capped away from 'huge ass' while Butt + asks for it).
Merge: identical concepts of one phase from two sliders are computed once, at the stronger scale (Breasts -2 and Pectorals -2: one 'flat chest').

Stretch marks (Hair & marks) and Cellulite (Skin): skin details like the marks, masks read from their own nouns, never on the face. Cellulite is off in Anime (no usable tag); Danbooru's stretch_marks tag is rare, so Anime is weak there.

'ref': true on a step (-1 sparse chest hair, -1 lightly toned body, -1 half-erect): that step is only where the push is measured from, never pushed toward. The minus side then only takes away: a hairless chest stays hairless at -1, a hairy one gets less hair. The opposite push carries the edit, at toward strength.

Pose style (Pose tab): -2 powerful, -1 confident, +1 graceful, +2 sensual; the character's bearing, for anyone (the prompt says who). Pose energy is how much motion. Pose energy - with Pose style is a clash (arms at sides vs crossed arms / hand on hip), softened.

by_scene (Pose style): the slider's profile tables have 'women', 'men' and 'any' (no gender, or both: then it is off as mixed_scene says); futa read as women, cuntboys as men. 'variants' in an entry: each image of the batch takes one, by its seed (the same seed always the same pose).

Genitals as shape + detail: Penis size and Penis girth (shape, fused with Erection), Veins / Wetness / Foreskin (detail); Testicles (shape), Scrotum tight <-> hanging (detail, waits for the testicles); Labia, Vulva puffiness, Vulva texture (detail, small masks, fused). anime tags thick penis / puffy pussy are e621's (Pony), not Danbooru's.
No fluid in a shape step: precum is Penis wetness's (detail), never Erection's; a shape concept naming a fluid would draw it in the first, composition-setting steps and fight Penis wetness.

Above Max concepts, detail sliders first lose their caps, then their counter-pushes, before anything takes turns ('• N detail caps / counter-pushes left out'). 'spots' (scars, moles, birthmarks, freckles, stretch marks) do not count toward region_warn: they dot the skin, they do not pile up on one spot.
